text:
ana: T-minus 25 until freeze window starts (22:00 UTC). Quick pre-flight thread for the eu-west canary + cost guardrails.

toby: I'm on runtime watch — p90/p95 and cache hit-rate. Adding blackbox probes to the dashboard now.

harry: I'll manage cost limits for embedding routes. Setting provisional cap and reducing max batch to 6 for canary.

ana: (typo, ignore)

ana: whoops meant ana :)

ana: Copy/paste rollout plan and hard checks:
```
- freeze window: 22:00 - 23:30 UTC (no non-emergency deploys)
- canary: 4 instances eu-west-1 running v1.13.0-canary
- traffic ramp: 5% -> 20% over 10m -> hold 30m -> region-stagger to 60%
- cost mitigations: embedding cap 200 req/s, batch_size=6, reserve 10% capacity
- rollback target: v1.12.9 pinned as immediate fallback
- monitors: p95 latency, 5xx rate, cost burn, KV cache hit
- auto-rollback thresholds: 5xx > 0.4% sustained 3m OR p95 +120ms
- manual-unfreeze: ops-lead + ana authorization required
```

ops-lead: Confirming manual-unfreeze flow. I'll be available in #release-control for sign-off.

sre-ops: Dashboards live. Added a synthetic check to surface KV cache evictions. Alert binding: page on critical, slack on warn.

release-bot: release notes published: https://console.internal/releases/1.13.0-canary — includes embedding behavior note and quant flag doc.

harry: Note: quantization stays disabled for canary to avoid outlier latency. We'll flip in later stage if stable.

deploy-bot: pin set: v1.13.0-canary -> eu-west-1 (4 nodes)
deploy-bot: canary started (ids: i-eu1a, i-eu1b, i-eu1c, i-eu1d)

(5m later)

deploy-bot: health update: 7m elapsed, 0.12% 5xx, p95 +22ms vs baseline. Proceeding to 20% ramp.

ana: Holding at 20% for 30m. Please post concise status updates every 10m.

toby: Watching p90/p95 and thread-level errors. Not seeing any request-level regressions. Cache hit stable at 98%.

harry: Cost burn within expected band after batch size reduce. Keeping embedding cap active.

(10m into hold)

deploy-bot: health update: 12m elapsed, 5xx=0.28%, p95 +35ms. No threshold breach.

sre-ops: Noted a small uptick in 502 spikes from edge (likely transient). I am opening a tail-sampling trace for the window.

ops-lead: If 5xx crosses 0.4% sustained for 3m we trigger rollback. Stand by.

(25m into hold)

deploy-bot: health update: 27m elapsed, 5xx=0.33%, p95 +40ms, cost steady.

ana: Given metrics, continue stagger to next region after hold. No rollback yet.

(hold end)

sre-ops: Traces show a spike concentrated on a single routing shard. Mitigation: re-route to healthy shards for next stage.

deploy-bot: traffic cutover: starting stagger to 60% across eu-west and eu-central.

harry: Increasing reserve capacity to 15% for safety margin during stagger.

(5m into stagger)

deploy-bot: health update: 5m after stagger start, 5xx=0.38%, p95 +48ms. Close to threshold; monitoring closely.

ops-lead: Stand ready to manual-unfreeze. If we breach 0.4% for 3m I need signoff to unfreeze and roll back.

(3m later)

deploy-bot: health update: 3m sustained 5xx=0.42% -> auto-rollback condition met. Initiating emergency rollback to v1.12.9.

deploy-bot: rollback started: `./ops/rollback --to v1.12.9 --reason "canary 5xx breach"`

sre-ops: Rolling logs and traces show increased backend timeout to upstream LLM calls. Kicking infra failover patch.

harry: Throttles re-applied on embedding endpoints to reduce downstream pressure. Cost caps still active.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. All traffic on fallback v1.12.9. Canary instances terminated.

ops-lead: Rollback acknowledged. Good catch. We'll file a postmortem if instability persists in next attempts.

ana: Moving freeze to hold until we can validate upstream timeouts fixed. New tentative window review tomorrow 21:00 UTC.

release-bot: Post-rollback note added to release: https://console.internal/releases/1.13.0-canary/notes — include rollback timeline and immediate mitigations.

ana: Thanks all. Short follow-ups only in this thread; broader write-up in #release-postmortems tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
